summary: Verified the external-video-URL bug-fix (413 workaround). Backend endpoint POST /api/admin/sessions/{sid}/video-url now accepts ANY https URL (YouTube, Vimeo, Cloudflare, direct CDN, Supabase bucket) and rejects non-http/ftp/empty with 400. Signed-URL endpoint returns max_bytes=5GB. Frontend VideoEditor 'Use URL' flow works end-to-end and the AdminPanel Session-Videos tab per-row 'URL' button prompts + saves correctly. All 9 pytest tests pass; both FE flows verified via Playwright.

issues: Frontend webpack currently compiles WITH 1 UNRELATED ERROR: `./src/components/simulations/HyperFormulaSpreadsheet.jsx:1610 — export 'FixedSizeGrid' (imported as 'FixedSizeGrid') was not found in 'react-window' (possible exports: Grid, List, ...)`. Root cause: react-window ^2.x removed FixedSizeGrid (now `Grid`). This is COMPLETELY UNRELATED to the video-upload bug fix, but it renders a red webpack-dev overlay that hides the login and every page until dismissed. I dismissed it programmatically during tests. Main agent should update HyperFormulaSpreadsheet.jsx to use the new `Grid` API or pin react-window to a 1.x version.

action_items: (UNRELATED to this bug fix) Fix `FixedSizeGrid` import in /app/frontend/src/components/simulations/HyperFormulaSpreadsheet.jsx — react-window v2 renamed it to `Grid`. This webpack error currently blocks all UI with a red overlay on first load.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend `admin_save_video_url` (wave_endpoints.py:1107) is correct — now accepts any https URL and persists it via _supabase_patch. Good validation with .startswith(('http://','https://')).
Note: the endpoint accepts BOTH http:// and https:// — the review request mentions 'ANY https URL'. Accepting http:// is a minor deviation but not a bug (external providers will normally give https).

The old test file /app/backend/tests/test_admin_video_signed_url.py has 2 stale assertions that now fail against the new behaviour: line 112 asserts max_bytes==500MB (now 5GB) and step 5 (line 210) asserts a non-bucket URL returns 400 (now returns 200). Consider deleting or updating that file — the new /app/backend/tests/test_admin_video_url_external.py supersedes it.

Footer text lists all required providers (50MB / 50GB / YouTube / Vimeo / Cloudflare Stream / Mux / BunnyCDN).
